answer.summary: Zhao recalled that someone sent dog treats to Notion’s office, even though its address wasn’t public—a surprising sign that investors were tracking the company and trying to get its attention.

sections.heading: Unexpected sign
sections.content: Zhao said dog treats arrived at Notion’s office, whose address wasn’t public. He realized someone had worked out where the office was and followed Notion on Twitter; he took this as a sign that the company had enough attraction to investors. The interviewer suggested it was a gift intended to get a meeting, and Zhao agreed.
